title: Pesto Chicken with Garlic-Butter Vegetables
description: An independently drafted menu-inspired chicken dinner with pesto and buttery seasonal vegetables.
steps: Boil diced potatoes until tender; add beans for the final 4 minutes, then drain.
Season chicken and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side; rest before slicing.
Melt butter with crushed garlic, toss through the vegetables and fold pesto through the chicken.
Serve chicken with the garlic vegetables.

title: Peppered Beef Stir-Fry with Capsicum and Jasmine Rice
description: Quick peppery beef, crisp capsicum and rice in a savoury pan sauce.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Season beef generously with pepper and sear in a hot oiled pan in batches; set aside.
Stir-fry sliced capsicums until just tender, return beef and add soy sauce with a splash of water.
Toss until glossy and serve over rice.

title: Pulled Pork and Caramelised Apple Rolls
description: Soft rolls filled with tender pulled pork, sweet apple and crunchy root-vegetable chips.
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut carrot and parsnip into chips, coat lightly in oil and roast until browned, about 25 minutes.
Warm pork with barbecue sauce in a covered pan until piping hot.
Thinly slice apples and cook in a pan until softened and golden at the edges.
Fill warm rolls with pork and apple; serve with root-vegetable chips.

title: Fish and Vegetable Pot Pies
description: Individual fish pies topped with golden parmesan potato mash.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil potatoes until soft, mash with a splash of milk and parmesan.
Dice fish and carrot; simmer with peas, remaining milk and a spoon of flour until fish is just opaque and sauce thickens.
Spoon filling into ovenproof dishes and spread mash over the top.
Bake until bubbling and golden, 15-20 minutes; check fish is fully cooked.

title: Smoky Barbecue Chicken and Slaw Tacos
description: Smoky chicken tacos with crisp cabbage and a bright tomato salsa.
steps: Season chicken with paprika, salt and oil; pan-fry until browned and cooked through, then slice.
Finely shred cabbage and toss with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Dice tomatoes and mix with a little lime for a quick salsa.
Warm tortillas, fill with chicken, slaw and salsa.

title: Kofta-Spiced Beef Meatballs with Turmeric Rice
description: Fragrant spiced beef meatballs served with vegetable-studded rice and cool yoghurt.
steps: Mix beef with cumin, salt and pepper; shape into small meatballs.
Rinse rice, add turmeric and cook according to packet directions with finely diced carrot.
Pan-fry meatballs, turning often, until browned and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve meatballs over rice with yoghurt.

title: Smoky Lamb Fajitas with Charred Flatbread
description: Spiced lamb and peppers tucked into warm flatbread with fresh tomato salsa.
steps: Season lamb with paprika, salt and oil. Sear in a hot pan until cooked to your liking; rest briefly.
Char sliced capsicum in the same pan until softened and lightly blistered.
Dice tomatoes and season with lime juice and salt.
Warm flatbreads in a dry pan, then fill with lamb, capsicum and salsa.

title: Fast Japanese Pork Bowl with Rice, Lettuce and Peanuts
description: A savoury pork and rice bowl finished with crunchy lettuce and peanuts.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Brown pork mince in a hot pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in soy sauce, sugar and two tablespoons of water; simmer until glossy and pork is cooked through.
Serve over rice with shredded lettuce and chopped peanuts.

title: Chicken Yaki Udon with Crisp-Fried Leek
description: Chewy udon noodles tossed with chicken and vegetables, topped with crunchy leek.
steps: Prepare udon according to packet directions and drain.
Thinly slice leek; crisp half in a little oil and set aside. Slice chicken and carrot.
Stir-fry chicken until cooked through, add carrot and remaining leek, then toss in noodles, soy and sesame oil.
Serve topped with crisp leek.

title: Smoky Barbecue Beef and Pumpkin Bowl
description: A colourful bowl of smoky beef, roasted pumpkin, beans, rice and avocado.
steps: Roast diced pumpkin at 220°C with oil and salt until tender and browned, about 25 minutes.
Cook rice; rinse and warm the beans in a small pan.
Sear beef in a hot pan until cooked to your liking, then toss with barbecue sauce.
Build bowls with rice, beans, pumpkin, sliced beef and avocado.

title: Spicy Blackened Basa Po' Boy
description: A crisp fish sandwich with sweet-potato wedges and tangy cucumber pickle.
steps: Heat oven to 220°C. Cut sweet potato into wedges, oil and roast until crisp and tender.
Season fish with paprika, salt and pepper; pan-fry until opaque and flaky.
Thinly slice cucumber and toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Spread mayonnaise in rolls, add fish and cucumber, and serve with wedges.

title: Chicken Cobb Salad with Avocado and Yoghurt Ranch
description: A hearty chopped salad with warm chicken, egg, avocado and a herby yoghurt dressing.
steps: Hard-boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Season chicken and pan-fry until cooked through; rest and slice.
Mix yoghurt, dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper for the dressing.
Arrange leaves, sliced avocado, eggs and chicken; drizzle with dressing.

title: Falafel, Loaded Hummus and Pita Chips
description: Crisp pita chips and falafel served over hummus with a fresh chopped salad.
steps: Cut pita into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 200°C until crisp, about 10 minutes.
Cook falafel according to packet directions until hot and golden.
Dice cucumber and tomato, then toss with lemon juice and salt.
Spread hummus on plates, top with falafel and salad, and serve with pita chips.

title: Mushroom 'Meat' Tacos with Carrot Slaw
description: Savoury mushroom tacos with crunchy carrot and cabbage slaw and smoky sauce.
steps: Finely chop mushrooms and cook in a hot pan until their moisture evaporates and edges brown.
Season with paprika, salt and pepper; cook for another minute.
Grate carrot, shred cabbage and toss with a little vinegar and mayonnaise.
Warm tortillas and fill with mushrooms and slaw.

title: Crunchy Miso Chicken and Ginger Rice
description: Golden miso chicken served with ginger rice and a bright avocado-edamame salsa.
steps: Cook rice with grated ginger according to packet directions; cook edamame until tender.
Coat chicken with miso thinned with a spoonful of water, then press into panko.
Pan-fry in a shallow layer of oil until golden and cooked through, turning carefully.
Serve sliced chicken with ginger rice, edamame and diced avocado dressed with lime.

title: Easy Asian Barbecue Chicken with Udon Noodles
description: Sticky barbecue chicken with quick-cooked udon and colourful vegetables.
steps: Prepare udon according to packet directions.
Slice chicken and cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add capsicum and broccoli with a splash of water; cover briefly to steam until crisp-tender.
Stir in barbecue sauce, soy and noodles; toss to coat and heat through.

title: Fast Smoky Chorizo Gnocchi with Spinach
description: Pan-crisped gnocchi with smoky chorizo, tomatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Slice chorizo and fry until browned; remove and set aside, leaving the oil in the pan.
Add gnocchi and cook until golden, turning often.
Add garlic and tomatoes; cook until tomatoes soften and gnocchi are tender.
Return chorizo, fold through spinach until wilted, and finish with parmesan.

title: Kofta-Spiced Salmon with Rice and Roast Vegetables
description: Warmly spiced salmon with rice and a tray of caramelised vegetables.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Chop zucchini and capsicum, toss with oil and roast until tender.
Cook rice according to packet directions.
Rub salmon with cumin, salt and oil; bake or pan-sear until opaque and just flaking.
Serve salmon with rice, roast vegetables and lemon wedges.

title: Beef Rump Steaks and Salsa Verde
description: Seared rump steaks with crisp hasselback potatoes and punchy herb sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Make thin cuts across each potato without cutting through; oil, season and roast until crisp and tender.
Finely chop parsley and capers; mix with olive oil, lemon juice and black pepper.
Season steaks and sear in a hot pan to your preferred doneness; rest for 5 minutes.
Slice steak across the grain and serve with potatoes and salsa verde.

title: Crunchy Fish Katsu Rice Bowls
description: Crisp crumbed fish over rice with avocado, radish and seaweed.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Cut fish into portions, coat in flour, beaten egg and panko, then shallow-fry until crisp and cooked through.
Slice avocado and radish; cut or crumble nori.
Serve fish over rice with vegetables and a little soy sauce.

title: BBQ Balinese Satay Chicken with Rice
description: Grilled satay-style chicken with rice and charred cabbage salad.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Whisk peanut butter with soy, lime juice and warm water to make a pourable sauce.
Thread chicken pieces onto skewers and grill or pan-sear until browned and cooked through.
Char cabbage wedges in a hot pan and serve with rice, chicken and satay sauce.

title: Chargrilled Pork Steaks with Country Potatoes
description: Juicy pork with crispy potatoes and a tangy, smoky cabbage slaw.
steps: Cut potatoes into chunks, season and roast at 220°C until golden and tender.
Shred cabbage and toss with vinegar, yoghurt, paprika and salt.
Season pork and grill or sear until cooked through; rest for 3 minutes.
Serve pork with potatoes and smoky slaw.

title: Garlic Ginger Prawns with Spicy Asian Slaw
description: Quick garlic prawns with crunchy cabbage, chilli and toasted coconut.
steps: Toast coconut in a dry pan until golden; set aside.
Shred cabbage and carrot and dress with lime juice, a little oil and sliced chilli.
Fry garlic and ginger briefly, add prawns and cook until pink and opaque.
Serve prawns with slaw and toasted coconut.

title: Barramundi with Sweet Soy Greens
description: Pan-seared barramundi with green vegetables and oven-baked potato wedges.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges and roast at 220°C until golden.
Mix soy sauce, honey, crushed garlic and a spoonful of water.
Steam broccoli until just tender; pan-sear barramundi until opaque and flaky.
Spoon sweet soy sauce over fish and greens; serve with wedges.

title: Smoky Haloumi Tacos with Creamy Cabbage Slaw
description: Seared haloumi tucked into warm tortillas with a cool, tangy slaw.
steps: Shred cabbage and toss with yoghurt, lime juice and salt.
Slice haloumi and dust lightly with smoked paprika.
Sear haloumi in a hot dry pan until golden on both sides.
Warm tortillas and fill with haloumi and creamy slaw.

title: Malaysian Tofu with Cucumber Salsa and Broccoli
description: Crisp tofu with a coconut-spiced sauce, fresh cucumber salsa and broccoli.
steps: Pat tofu dry, cube and pan-fry until golden; set aside.
Simmer curry paste in a little oil, add coconut milk and broccoli, and cook until broccoli is tender.
Return tofu and simmer gently until warmed through.
Dice cucumber and dress with lime; serve salsa alongside the tofu curry.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
description: A spiced chicken burger with crisp sweet-potato fries and fresh salad.
steps: Cut sweet potato into fries, season and roast at 220°C until tender and browned.
Season chicken with paprika, salt and oil; cook in a pan until fully cooked.
Toast buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Build burgers with chicken and lettuce; serve with sweet-potato fries.

title: Sweet Ginger Beef Stir-Fry with Sesame Rice
description: Ginger-glazed beef and crisp pak choy over nutty sesame rice.
steps: Cook rice, then stir in a teaspoon of toasted sesame oil.
Mix soy, honey, grated ginger and a splash of water.
Sear beef in a hot pan, add sliced pak choy and stir-fry until just wilted.
Pour in sauce and toss until glossy; serve with sesame rice.

title: Tex-Mex Haloumi Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
description: Golden haloumi burgers with paprika fries and crunchy lettuce.
steps: Cut sweet potato into fries, season with paprika and roast at 220°C until tender.
Slice haloumi and sear in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Toast buns and slice avocado and lettuce.
Fill buns with haloumi, avocado and lettuce; serve with fries.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pot Pie
description: A comforting chicken and vegetable filling under a cheesy mashed-potato crust.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Boil potatoes until tender, mash with milk and half the cheese.
Dice chicken and carrot; cook in a pan until chicken is browned, then add peas and a simple flour-thickened stock sauce.
Transfer filling to an ovenproof dish and spread mash over the top; scatter over remaining cheese.
Bake until bubbling and golden, about 20 minutes; ensure chicken is cooked through.

title: Smoky Beef Burgers and Wedges
description: Homemade smoky beef patties with potato wedges and a fresh garden salad.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, oil and roast at 220°C until crisp and cooked through.
Season beef with paprika, salt and pepper; shape into patties and pan-fry until fully cooked.
Toast buns and slice tomatoes.
Assemble burgers with salad leaves and tomato; serve with wedges.

title: Chicken and Potato Salad with Tomato, Dill and Egg
description: A satisfying warm salad with tender chicken, potatoes and a tangy dill dressing.
steps: Boil potatoes until tender; hard-boil eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Season chicken and pan-fry until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Whisk olive oil with vinegar, dill, salt and pepper.
Toss warm potatoes with dressing and tomato; top with chicken and egg.

title: Smoky Haloumi Burgers and Wedges
description: Golden haloumi burgers with crisp potato wedges and a simple garden salad.
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with paprika and oil, and roast at 220°C until crisp.
Slice haloumi and sear in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Toast buns and slice tomato.
Assemble burgers with haloumi and salad leaves; serve with wedges.

title: Fast Steakhouse Beef Nachos with Guacamole
description: Weeknight beef nachos with quick guacamole, tomato and melted cheese.
steps: Heat oven to 200°C. Brown beef mince in a pan and season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Stir in drained beans, then layer beef and chips in an ovenproof dish; scatter over cheese.
Bake until cheese melts, about 8 minutes.
Mash avocado with lime and salt, dice tomato, and serve with the hot nachos.

title: Spicy Tex-Mex Beef Tacos with Creamy Slaw
description: Chilli-spiced beef tacos with cool slaw and a smoky mustard dressing.
steps: Brown beef mince with chipotle, cumin and a splash of water until cooked through.
Shred cabbage and toss with yoghurt, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with beef and creamy slaw; adjust chilli to taste.

title: Parmesan Chicken and Roast Potato
description: Crisp parmesan-coated chicken with roasted potatoes and a ribboned vegetable salad.
steps: Roast diced potatoes at 220°C with oil and salt until golden and tender.
Coat chicken in beaten egg and grated parmesan; bake or pan-fry until cooked through and crisp.
Use a peeler to make ribbons of zucchini and carrot; dress with lemon and olive oil.
Serve chicken with roast potatoes and vegetable ribbons.

title: Tofu, Noodle and Sweet Soy Stir-Fry
description: Golden tofu noodles with green beans and carrot in a sweet soy glaze.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Pat tofu dry, cube and fry until golden on all sides.
Add sliced beans and carrot with a splash of water; stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Add noodles, soy sauce and sugar; toss until coated and hot.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry with Ginger and Oyster Sauce
description: Chicken and noodles tossed with ginger, crunchy greens and a savoury sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Stir-fry sliced chicken until cooked through; add grated ginger, broccoli and carrot.
Add a splash of water and cover briefly to soften the vegetables.
Toss in noodles and oyster sauce; heat through and serve.

title: Smoky Chicken Tacos with Creamy Slaw
description: Smoky pan-cooked chicken in soft tortillas with a cool creamy cabbage slaw.
steps: Season chicken with paprika, salt and oil; cook in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Shred cabbage and toss with mayonnaise, lime juice and salt.
Rest chicken briefly, then slice into strips.
Warm tortillas and fill with chicken and creamy slaw.

title: Chicken and Green Bean Braise with Cheesy Potatoes
description: A homestyle chicken and bean braise served with golden cheesy potatoes.
steps: Roast diced potatoes at 220°C until tender; sprinkle with cheddar for the final 5 minutes.
Brown chicken and sliced onion in a deep pan.
Add stock, cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Add green beans and simmer until tender; serve with cheesy potatoes.

title: Beef, Noodle and Sweet Soy Stir-Fry
description: Quick beef noodles with green beans and carrot in a sweet soy sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions.
Sear beef in a hot pan in batches, then set aside.
Stir-fry sliced beans and carrot until crisp-tender.
Return beef, add noodles, soy and honey, and toss until hot and glossy.

title: Smoked Salmon Sushi Bowl with Avocado and Cucumber
description: A quick sushi-inspired rice bowl with smoked salmon and lime dressing.
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to packet directions; season lightly with rice vinegar.
Mix mayonnaise with lime juice and a little water to make a drizzle.
Slice cucumber, avocado and smoked salmon.
Divide rice among bowls and top with salmon, vegetables and lime mayonnaise.

title: Fast Family Beef Mince Tacos
description: Easy beef tacos with avocado, tomato and cheddar for a build-your-own dinner.
steps: Brown beef mince in a pan, breaking it up; season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Dice tomatoes and avocado and grate cheddar.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or according to packet directions.
Set out the beef and toppings so everyone can assemble their own tacos.

title: Beef Oyster Sauce Noodles with Honey and Pak Choy
description: Savoury beef noodles with tender greens and a touch of honey.
steps: Cook noodles according to packet directions and drain.
Sear beef in a hot pan until browned; add carrot and pak choy.
Stir together oyster sauce, honey and a splash of water, then pour into the pan.
Toss with noodles until hot and coated.

title: Pizzaiola-Style Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
description: Tomato-braised chicken with roasted seasonal vegetables and herbs.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Roast diced potato, zucchini and capsicum with oil until tender.
Season chicken and brown in an ovenproof pan.
Add tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper; simmer briefly, then cover and cook until chicken is done.
Serve chicken and tomato sauce with roast vegetables.

title: Crispy Chicken Schnitzel Burger with Slaw
description: Crunchy chicken schnitzel in a bun with cabbage slaw and smoky mayonnaise.
steps: Flatten chicken breasts evenly; coat in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow-fry until crisp, golden and cooked through; drain on paper towel.
Shred cabbage and toss with a spoonful of mayonnaise and vinegar.
Mix remaining mayonnaise with paprika, spread in toasted buns and add chicken and slaw.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Risotto
description: Comforting mushroom risotto finished with spinach and toasted pepitas.
steps: Warm stock in a saucepan. Toast pepitas in a dry pan and set aside.
Cook sliced mushrooms in butter until browned; stir in rice and coat the grains.
Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often until absorbed and rice is creamy and tender.
Fold in spinach and parmesan; serve topped with pepitas.

title: Mini Beef Meatloaves with Parmesan Wedges
description: Small glazed beef loaves with roast potatoes and wilted spinach.
steps: Heat oven to 210°C. Cut potatoes into wedges and roast with oil and salt.
Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, grated parmesan and seasoning; shape into four small loaves.
Bake loaves beside the potatoes until browned and cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Wilt spinach in a pan and serve with meatloaves and wedges.

title: Banh Mi-Style Pork Jasmine Rice Bowl
description: Gingered pork over jasmine rice with quick-pickled vegetables and fresh herbs.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Julienne carrot and toss with rice vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt; leave to pickle briefly.
Brown pork mince with garlic and ginger until cooked through; season with soy sauce.
Serve pork over rice with snow peas, pickled carrot and coriander.

title: Ginger-Sesame Pork and Jasmine Rice
description: Glazed pork with rice, quick-pickled vegetables and tender broccoli.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Thinly slice cucumber and toss with vinegar and a pinch of salt; set aside.
Sear pork with grated ginger until cooked through; add soy and a little honey to glaze.
Steam broccoli and serve with rice, pork, pickled cucumber and sesame seeds.

title: Sesame Chicken Katsu and Japanese Slaw
description: Crisp sesame-crusted chicken with rice and a bright cabbage slaw.
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions.
Mix panko with sesame seeds; coat flattened chicken in flour, egg and crumbs.
Shallow-fry chicken until golden and cooked through, turning once.
Shred cabbage and dress with lime and a little oil; serve with sliced chicken and rice.

title: Japanese Beef Bowl with Rice and Peanuts
description: Quick ginger-soy beef, crisp lettuce, rice and roasted peanuts in a bright weeknight bowl.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook according to the packet. Thinly slice the lettuce and grate the carrot.
Mix soy sauce, grated ginger, lime juice and 2 tablespoons of water. Toast the peanuts in a dry pan and set aside.
Heat oil in the pan over high heat. Sear the beef in batches until browned and cooked through, then pour in the ginger-soy sauce and bubble for 1 minute.
Serve the beef and sauce over rice with lettuce, carrot and peanuts.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Pork Potstickers with Sesame Slaw
description: Crisp-bottomed dumplings with a quick cabbage slaw and tangy chilli-sesame dressing.
steps: Combine pork mince, half the sliced spring onion and 1 teaspoon soy sauce. Fill each wrapper with a teaspoon of mixture; wet and press the edges to seal.
Finely shred cabbage and carrot. Toss with rice vinegar, sesame oil and the remaining soy sauce.
Brown dumplings in a covered non-stick pan with oil for 2 minutes. Add 100 ml water, cover and steam for 7–8 minutes until the pork is cooked through and wrappers are tender.
Serve dumplings with slaw and the remaining spring onion. Cook in batches if needed.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Pork Sausage Pasta with Kale and Fennel
description: A quick tomatoey sausage pasta brightened with tender kale, fennel and parmesan.
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until just tender. Reserve a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Remove sausage casings and break the meat into a hot oiled pan. Brown for 5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add thinly sliced fennel and garlic; cook for 3 minutes. Stir in tomato and oregano, then simmer for 10 minutes. Add chopped kale for the final 3 minutes.
Toss pasta through the sauce, loosening with a splash of pasta water. Finish with grated parmesan.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Smoky Chicken and Black Bean Soup
description: A hearty chipotle-spiced soup with black beans, corn, avocado and fresh lime.
steps: Dice the onion and chicken. Heat oil in a saucepan and soften the onion for 4 minutes.
Stir in chipotle paste, then add chicken and cook until the outside turns opaque. Add tomato, stock and rinsed beans.
Simmer gently for 18–20 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Stir in corn and heat for 3 minutes; shred the chicken in the pot with two forks.
Season with lime juice and serve topped with diced avocado.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Lamb Koftas with Cauliflower Tabouleh
description: Cumin-scented lamb skewers served with herby cauliflower, tomato and lemon yoghurt.
steps: Mix lamb with cumin, coriander, half the chopped parsley and a pinch of salt. Shape into 6 short koftas.
Pulse cauliflower into coarse crumbs or grate it. Finely dice tomato and cucumber; mix with cauliflower, remaining parsley, lemon juice and a drizzle of oil.
Pan-fry koftas over medium-high heat, turning often, for 10–12 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Season yoghurt with lemon zest and a little juice. Serve koftas with cauliflower tabouleh and lemon yoghurt.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Teriyaki Pork Rice Bowl with Sesame Slaw
description: Sweet-savoury glazed pork over fluffy rice with crunchy cabbage and cucumber.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Thinly slice cabbage and cucumber and toss with rice vinegar and half the sesame seeds.
Mix soy sauce, honey, grated ginger and 2 tablespoons of water.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Cook pork mince, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through. Pour in the soy mixture and simmer until glossy.
Spoon pork over rice and serve with sesame slaw and the remaining seeds.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Poached Chicken and Potato Salad
description: Tender herbed chicken with warm potatoes, peppery leaves, radish and mustard dressing.
steps: Halve the potatoes and simmer in salted water for 15–18 minutes until tender. Drain.
Place chicken in a small saucepan with stock and enough water to cover. Bring just to a simmer, cover and poach gently for 12–15 minutes until cooked through; rest, then slice.
Whisk mustard, vinegar and olive oil with a spoonful of warm stock. Toss warm potatoes with half the dressing and chopped dill.
Arrange rocket, sliced radish, potatoes and chicken on plates. Spoon over the remaining dressing.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Laksa Chicken Wings with Pak Choy Rice
description: Oven-roasted aromatic wings with jasmine rice and greens in a coconut-lime sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Toss wings with oil and half the laksa paste; roast on a lined tray for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, rinse and cook rice according to the packet.
Simmer coconut milk, remaining laksa paste, sugar and 100 ml water for 5 minutes. Add chopped pak choy and cook until just tender.
Serve wings and sauce with rice, lime wedges and coriander.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Greek Chicken with Olives and Feta
description: A one-tray lemon-oregano chicken dinner with capsicum, zucchini, olives and feta.
steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Cut zucchini, capsicum and onion into bite-size pieces and arrange in a roasting dish.
Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, lemon zest and juice, salt and pepper. Nestle it among the vegetables.
Roast for 30–35 minutes, turning vegetables once, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender. Add olives for the final 5 minutes.
Crumble feta over the tray and serve with the lemony pan juices.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Spicy Mushroom and Gai Lan Stir-Fry
description: A savoury chilli mushroom stir-fry with Chinese broccoli, peanuts and steamed rice.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Slice mushrooms and gai lan; separate the thick stems from the leaves.
Stir soy sauce, chilli garlic sauce and 2 tablespoons of water together.
Heat oil in a wok. Sear mushrooms until golden, then add ginger, garlic and gai lan stems; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add leaves and sauce and cook until just tender.
Serve the vegetables over rice, topped with peanuts. Add extra chilli sauce to taste.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Chicken Alfredo with Spring Vegetables
description: Creamy parmesan pasta with seared chicken, peas and tender greens for an easy dinner.
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until just tender. Add peas for the final 2 minutes, then reserve a mug of pasta water and drain.
Slice chicken and season with pepper. Melt half the butter in a pan and cook chicken until golden and cooked through; transfer to a plate.
Melt remaining butter in the pan, add garlic and cook briefly. Stir in cream and parmesan and simmer gently until smooth.
Toss pasta, peas, spinach and chicken through the sauce, adding pasta water to loosen. Serve with extra parmesan.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Pumpkin Ravioli with Green Herb Sauce
description: Pillowy pumpkin pasta tossed with a bright spinach, basil and plant-based cheese sauce.
steps: Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry pan until fragrant; set aside.
Blend spinach, basil, garlic, plant-based parmesan, lemon zest and juice with olive oil and 2 tablespoons of water to make a loose sauce.
Boil ravioli according to the packet. Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain gently.
Toss ravioli with green sauce, loosening with pasta water. Finish with toasted pumpkin seeds.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Plant-Based Burgers with Red Slaw
description: Crisp veggie patties with beetroot-cabbage slaw and herby avocado dressing.
steps: Finely shred cabbage and grate beetroot. Toss with lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Mash avocado with vegan mayonnaise, chopped coriander and a squeeze of lime.
Pan-fry patties in oil according to the packet until browned and piping hot. Toast the buns cut-side down.
Spread avocado dressing on the buns, add patties and a generous pile of slaw.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Vegetable Dumplings with Teriyaki Rice
description: Golden veggie dumplings, sweet soy-glazed rice and crisp snow peas.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Thinly slice spring onion and trim snow peas.
Pan-fry dumplings in oil until their bases are golden. Add a splash of water, cover and steam according to the packet.
Stir teriyaki sauce and vinegar through the hot rice. Quickly stir-fry snow peas until bright green and crisp-tender.
Serve dumplings with teriyaki rice and snow peas, finished with spring onion and sesame seeds.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Chicken Dumplings with Snow Peas
description: Juicy chicken dumplings with a simple ginger-soy dip and steamed rice.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Steam snow peas for 2–3 minutes until bright green.
Cook dumplings in a covered pan following the packet directions; ensure the chicken filling is piping hot.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and finely grated ginger for a dipping sauce.
Serve dumplings and snow peas over rice with sliced spring onion and dipping sauce.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Green Chilli Fish Rice with Lemon Yoghurt
description: Flaky pan-seared fish with spiced rice, baby spinach and cooling lemon yoghurt.
steps: Rinse rice. Simmer it with stock and cumin, covered, until tender and the liquid is absorbed; fold through spinach.
Mix yoghurt with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and a pinch of salt.
Season fish and finely chopped chilli. Pan-sear in oil for 3–4 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until opaque and flaking easily.
Serve fish over spinach rice with lemon yoghurt and extra lemon wedges.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Beef Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato
description: A comforting beef and vegetable filling under a golden sweet-potato mash topping.
steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Peel and cube sweet potato; boil for 15 minutes until tender, then mash with butter and seasoning.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan. Cook diced onion and carrot for 5 minutes, then add beef mince and brown thoroughly.
Stir in tomato paste, stock and peas. Simmer for 8 minutes until thickened, then spoon into a small baking dish.
Spread mash over the filling and bake for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Cheesy Bean and Corn Baked Rice
description: A colourful one-pan rice bake with beans, sweet corn, charred capsicum and yoghurt.
steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Dice capsicum and rinse the beans.
Combine rice, beans, corn, capsicum, tomato, stock and paprika in a baking dish. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, stir, then cover and bake for another 5–10 minutes until the rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Scatter over grated cheddar and bake uncovered until melted. Serve with a spoonful of yoghurt.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Ginger Pork Mazesoba Noodles
description: Saucy pork and chewy noodles tossed with ginger, greens and crunchy sesame.
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet, drain and reserve a little cooking water. Slice bok choy and carrot.
Heat neutral oil in a wok. Cook pork mince with grated ginger and garlic until browned and cooked through.
Add carrot and bok choy stems and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add leaves, soy sauce, sesame oil and a splash of noodle water.
Toss noodles through the pork mixture until hot. Finish with sesame seeds.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Szechuan Chicken Lettuce Cups
description: Ginger-chilli chicken with crunchy vegetables, lettuce cups and brown rice.
steps: Cook brown rice according to the packet. Separate and wash large lettuce leaves.
Toast crushed Szechuan pepper in a dry pan for 30 seconds. Add oil, chicken mince and ginger; stir-fry until chicken is cooked through.
Add finely diced capsicum and grated carrot. Stir in soy sauce, vinegar and 2 tablespoons of water; cook for 2 minutes.
Spoon chicken into lettuce cups and serve with brown rice.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Sumac Chicken with Tomato Bulgur Salad
description: Lemony sumac chicken served with fluffy bulgur, tomato, zucchini and parsley.
steps: Pour hot stock over bulgur, cover and stand for 12 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Rub chicken with sumac, lemon zest, salt and a little oil. Pan-sear over medium heat for 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through; rest before slicing.
Dice zucchini and pan-fry until golden. Fold into bulgur with chopped tomato, parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve sliced chicken over the bulgur salad.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Gado-Gado Tofu Salad with Peanut Dressing
description: Crisp vegetables, seared tofu and rice with a creamy, limey peanut sauce.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Steam green beans until crisp-tender and slice cucumber and carrot into ribbons.
Whisk peanut butter with lime juice, soy sauce and 3 tablespoons of warm water to make a pourable dressing.
Pat tofu dry, cube it and pan-fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Serve rice with tofu and vegetables, drizzled with peanut dressing and scattered mint.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Cumin-Lime Fish with Corn and Sweet Potato
description: Spiced flaky fish with roasted sweet potato, corn and a fresh tomato-lime salsa.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with half the oil and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once.
Mix diced tomato and red onion with lime juice and chopped coriander to make a quick salsa.
Rub fish with cumin, salt and remaining oil. Pan-sear for 3–4 minutes per side until opaque and flaky. Warm corn in the same pan.
Serve fish with sweet potato, warm corn and tomato salsa.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Fast Beef Tacos with Corn Slaw
description: Smoky beef tacos with crunchy cabbage, sweet corn and a limey yoghurt sauce.
steps: Finely shred cabbage and mix with corn, lime juice and a pinch of salt. Stir lime zest into yoghurt.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Brown beef mince, breaking it up, then add cumin, paprika and 2 tablespoons of water. Cook until piping hot.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or according to the packet.
Fill tortillas with spiced beef and corn slaw; finish with lime yoghurt.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Golden Fish Katsu with Apple Slaw
description: Crispy crumbed fish, steamed rice and a refreshing apple-cabbage slaw.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Finely shred cabbage and apple and toss with mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon if available.
Set out flour, beaten egg and panko in separate bowls. Coat fish pieces in flour, egg and then crumbs.
Shallow-fry fish in oil over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.
Serve crispy fish with rice and apple slaw.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Smoked Salmon, Feta and White Bean Salad
description: A fresh, protein-rich salad of smoked salmon, creamy beans, cucumber, dill and lemon.
steps: Rinse and drain beans. Halve tomatoes and dice cucumber.
Whisk lemon juice and zest with olive oil, chopped dill and black pepper.
Toss beans, tomatoes, cucumber and spinach with the dressing.
Top with torn smoked salmon and crumbled feta. Serve straight away.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Pork Noodle Stir-Fry with Green Beans
description: Quick pork and noodles with crisp beans, carrot and a savoury peanut-soy sauce.
steps: Cook noodles according to the packet, drain and reserve a little cooking water. Trim beans and slice carrot thinly.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and 3 tablespoons of warm water.
Heat oil in a wok. Stir-fry pork in batches until browned and cooked through. Add ginger, beans and carrot and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Add noodles and peanut sauce; toss until hot and glossy, adding noodle water to loosen.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Falafel and Grains with Green Goddess Sauce
description: Crispy falafel, warm grains and crunchy vegetables under a fresh herb sauce.
steps: Cook quinoa and brown rice according to their packets; combine and fluff with a fork.
Bake or pan-fry falafel according to the packet until crisp and hot.
Blend parsley, tahini, lemon juice, olive oil and 3 tablespoons of water into a pourable herb sauce.
Serve grains with cucumber, tomatoes, spinach and falafel, drizzled with green sauce.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Roast Pumpkin and Beans with Cucumber Salsa
description: Caramelised pumpkin and butter beans with a cool cucumber salsa and toasted seeds.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut pumpkin into wedges and toss with oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Roast pumpkin for 25–30 minutes until tender and caramelised at the edges. Toast pumpkin seeds in a dry pan.
Dice cucumber and red onion; toss with lemon juice and chopped mint.
Warm rinsed butter beans in a small pan. Serve with pumpkin, cucumber salsa and toasted seeds.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Sriracha Veggie Burgers with Sweet Potato
description: Spiced veggie burgers with sweet-potato wedges and a creamy, tangy sauce.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with oil and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once.
Mix mayonnaise with sriracha and a squeeze of lime.
Cook patties according to the packet until golden and hot throughout. Toast the buns lightly.
Build burgers with spinach and sriracha mayo; serve with sweet-potato wedges.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Chicken Nuggets with Wedges and Honey Mustard
description: Crunchy homemade chicken bites with oven chips and a quick honey-mustard yoghurt dip.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with half the oil and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once.
Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Coat each in flour, beaten egg, then panko; place on a lined tray and drizzle with remaining oil.
Bake chicken for 15–18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Stir honey and mustard into yoghurt. Serve nuggets and wedges with the dip.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Spicy Pork Fajita Tacos
description: Smoky pork with capsicum, avocado, spinach and fresh tomato salsa in warm tortillas.
steps: Dice tomato and mix with lime juice and a pinch of salt. Slice avocado and capsicum.
Toss pork with cumin, paprika and a little oil. Sear in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes until tender-crisp. Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with spinach, pork, capsicum, avocado and tomato salsa.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Garlic-Pepper Beef with Snow Peas
description: A fast wok dinner of peppery beef, crisp snow peas and oyster-soy rice.
steps: Cook rice according to the packet. Trim snow peas and slice spring onion.
Mix oyster sauce, soy sauce, crushed garlic, black pepper and 2 tablespoons of water.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Sear beef in batches until browned, then return it all to the pan with snow peas.
Add sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes until glossy and beef is cooked through. Serve with rice and spring onion.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.

title: Red Pesto Chicken with Potato Wedges
description: Juicy red-pesto chicken served with crisp wedges and a simple green salad.
steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with half the oil and roast for 30–35 minutes, turning once.
Spread pesto over chicken breasts and place on a lined tray. Bake for 18–22 minutes until cooked through; rest for 5 minutes.
Toss spinach, sliced cucumber and halved tomatoes with lemon juice and remaining oil.
Slice the chicken and serve with wedges and salad.
notes: Original home-cook adaptation inspired by dishes listed on the Marley Spoon Australia menu; not an official Marley Spoon recipe.
